text.p: British catering equipment and home improvement group Berisford International Plc said that trading has continued the "encouraging trend" seen in the first half of the financial year.

"We are pleased with the profitable progress made by both businesses in the first and are encouraged by the first eight weeks trading of our second half year," said chairman John Sclater in the results statement.
The Welbit catering equipment unit saw sales up 10 percent in the first eight weeks against the same period last year, while sales at the Magnet home improvements unit were up six percent.

The group reported a 14 percent increase in pre-tax profits before exceptional items of 14.5 million stg in the half year to March 29, 1997, and a 33 percent jump in the interim dividend to 2.0 pence per share.
Turnover was 261.0 million stg, of which 147.8 million was generated by Welbit and 111.8 million by Magnet.
